explanation: The email column's null_rate rose from 0.0205 (2.1%) yesterday to 0.6054 (60.5%) today — a ~30x surge. Distinct count is unchanged (1584) and top-value frequencies fell roughly proportionally (e.g. 52->25), indicating rows were nulled at random rather than a vocabulary/format change. File size dropped ~11% (4.26MB->3.77MB), consistent with ~30k missing email strings. All other columns show only normal variation: order_id range shift is identifier drift (not drift per the rules), status vocabulary is unchanged, unit_price/amount min-max move only by cents with decimal_places still exactly 2, and order_date format/window, quantity, discount_pct, customer_name/customer_id are stable. Downstream analytics that join, dedupe, or aggregate on email will silently drop ~60% of today's rows.
